recipes.name: Adult Slushies
ingredients_raw: 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen lemonade concentrate
67 fluid ounces lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage

steps.text: Mix vodka, brandy, orange and lemon juice concentrate, cherries and grapefruit soda together in a large plastic mixing bowl. Cover the mixture with a tight fitting lid. Freeze the mixture for one or two days.
When you are ready to serve the drink, use an ice cream scoop and place one or two scoops of the mixture into glasses. Fill the rest of the glass with lemon/lime flavored soda pop. Stir and serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Adult Slushies
raw_recipe.description: This citrusy vodka drink, blended with brandy, grapefruit-flavored soda and juice concentrates, packs a punch that's both sweet and subtle.

review.reviewBody: Unbelievably easy and yummy. Makes a large batch. I added more vodka and brandy than what is called for and skipped the cherries. Perfect!

This was pretty tasty - served at party and was asked for recipe. I wasn't sure what to do with the cherries - drain - throw in there whole?! What I did was pour most but not all of the juice out and threw the cherries in my food processor and pulverized and then added to the mix. It turned a pretty pink color and gave it a little cherry flavor. I didn't use 2 jars of cherries, and am SO GLAD that I didn't. It would have been WAY too sweet as it was really sweet with just one jar. For the grapefruit soda, I used Fresca. I also increased the vodka and brandy to 1 cup each. ;-) I would make again.

This drink was a HUGE hit at a small dinner with friends. I made one small change, I pureed one 10-oz jar of cherries. This kept the sweetness under control and added a great color. I also needed more than one bottle of lemon lime soda. Don't substitute, ginger ale doesn't work.
Deeelicious! All the females at my bar b que lived it. Agreed, would skip the cherries next time or use half a cup. Grapefruit soda : called Squirt.

Made this for a co-workers b/day party ,to reduce sweetness i halved and blended the cherries and used club soda instead of the grapefruit ,must say these where awesome, just dont have to many before your guests arrive.
This was far too sweet for my taste even though I halved the amount of cherries in it. If I make it again, I'll omit the cherries entirely and try to give it a more citrus taste.

Mine is still freezing, but did anyone try this with diet soda instead of regular. I did and I am hoping that it freezes okay with out the sugar. Also were the cherries supposed to be drained I didn't and the color of my mix was an icky brown so I added red food coloring.
Every time i make this i get hit up for the recipe. It rocks:}
Very good. I tried it with Strawberry pop, and it was deliciouse but i think any kind of fruity pop would be good with it, maybe i'll pick up black cherry or grape next time.
Gotta say... These are wicked good! A little dangerous, so be careful *LoL* :)
This drink was loved by everybody!!!!
Very, very sweet, but good taste. Was looking for a drink with brandy for Super Bowl. I think next time I would skip the cherries, and use club soda instead of lemon-lime soda. Love the slushiness.
Tried this and it's a great summer treat!
Everything was super easy...except I couldn't find grapefruit soda. No one had ever heard of it. But other than that, we loved it!! We're going to add strawberries next time!
I made these slushies for my girlfriends on a warm weekend night. We enjoyed them immensely! Lots of gossip and laughs and we all agreed that these were great summer drinks to enjoy.
